title: 2.0 / The Logo
slide_intent: Explain the meaning attached to a mark so its use carries a coherent story.
strategic_value: The forward symbol can connect Spectrum’s name with discovery and product innovation.
demonstration: A cyan section number leads a dark blue heading over a pale gray gradient. The text explains the name and forward symbol and closes with an invitation to keep moving forward.
practical_value: Locate the logo chapter when assessing how the mark should retain its meaning and recognition.
